zh-CN.name: 动手前先头脑风暴
zh-CN.shortDesc: 实现前先澄清需求、给出设计并获得确认。可选的浏览器可视化助手需 Node.js；其页面默认从上游网站加载带版本号的徽标（遥测），可用环境变量关闭。

en-US.name: Brainstorming
en-US.shortDesc: Clarify requirements, propose a design and get approval before implementing. The optional browser visual companion needs Node.js; by default its page loads an upstream logo tagged with a version string (telemetry), which an environment variable turns off.
